observations.claim: Two selected fictional cases contain recorded acknowledgment exceptions; actual acknowledgment occurrence is unverified.

hypotheses.explanation: Acknowledgment capture may be inconsistent across administrative handoffs.
hypotheses.discriminating_check: Human review capture rules and linked acknowledgment evidence in a separately approved fictional investigation.
hypotheses.counterfactual: Consistent capture might reduce recorded acknowledgment exceptions; this is not established.

hypotheses.explanation: Delayed evidence ingestion may create apparent acknowledgment gaps.
hypotheses.discriminating_check: Human review feed delay and completeness evidence before comparing outcomes.
hypotheses.counterfactual: Timely ingestion might remove apparent gaps without changing actual handoffs.

controls.proposal: Pilot an administrative acknowledgment completeness check for human review.
controls.measure: Record acknowledgment exceptions divided by eligible handoffs; collect a bounded baseline before approval, compare pilot cohorts, and track false alerts and check fidelity.
controls.review_window: Define approved baseline and pilot windows before implementation.
controls.tradeoff: Additional review burden and false alerts from delayed feeds.

unknowns: Actual acknowledgment occurrence, feed completeness, process cause and population exception rate remain unknown.
